articles.title: Apparent Zcash outage was a block explorer problem, infrastructure provider says
articles.snippet: One expert said the issue was mainly with block explorers tracking the onchain activity.

articles.title: Trezor says your crypto is safe after Ledger audit exposes a hardware flaw
articles.snippet: The flaw affects only one of the wallet's multiple security layers and would require physical access, specialized equipment and advanced expertise to exploit.

articles.title: Zcash fixes Orchard bug after emergency network upgrade
articles.snippet: Zcash Open Development Lab said the network briefly became unstable as miners upgraded, while the Zcash Foundation said there was no evidence of an exploit.

articles.title: Zcash Completes 'Most Ambitious' Network Upgrade as ZEC Resumes Recent Surge
articles.snippet: A Zcash vulnerability could have allowed double-spending within the network's flagship privacy pool, though no exploitation occurred.
